newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 12.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
A commentary warns the United States to stop selling arms to Taiwan, saying the issue could ruin bilateral relations despite a recent warming trend.
China will step up efforts to try to limit urban unemployment at about three percent in 1997.
A commentary hails the selection of Hong Kong's first post-colonial chief executive as the beginning of democracy in the territory.
Investment in fixed assets is seen growing by 18.7 percent to 2.813 trillion yuan in 1997.
Retail sales are seen rising 12 percent in all of 1996 to 2.46 trillion yuan.
Total trade is forecast to rise by 3.3 percent this year to reach $290 billion.
China will hold the rural unemployment rate to within three percent in 1997.
